## Setup

First, we load the `tidyverse` package to give us tools for data manipulation and visualization.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

## Loading the Data

We read in the 5-year NCAA Division 1 volleyball dataset from the `data` directory.

```{r}
#| label: load-data

volleyball <- read_csv("data/ncaa_d1_volleyball_2020_2024.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

glimpse(volleyball)
```
